description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated request submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.
The ID of the user group.
The number of user API keys to create.

title.en: Create gateway user API keys in batches

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-batch-consumer --gw-cluster-id pg-xxxxxxxx --count 1 --consumer-group-id cg-xxxxxx --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
